trendlyne_description: Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Ltd. (SMIORE) is a diversified metals and mining entity based in India. With a history spanning over seven decades, the company has transitioned from a merchant miner to an integrated player in the steel and ferroalloys v... Read More
screener_description: The Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Limited (SMIORE), the flagship company of the Karnataka based Sandur Group, incorporated in 1954. Company is involved in mining of low phosphorous manganese and iron ore in the Hosapete Ballari region of Karnataka. In addition, Company manufactures ferro-alloys (silico-Manganese and ferro manganese) and coke at its plant in Vyasankare, near Hospet. [1] It is the 3rd Largest Manganese ore miner in India. [2]
